title: A JA Restaurant EmDash site made from a short brief: the main menu never shows one label twice, the home welcome is rewritten without the demo's year, address or map link, and a slideshow title longer than its contract bound is not taken
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-emdash.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-restaurant/tests/personalize-rich-copy.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-restaurant/tests/personalize-rich-translate.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-restaurant/tests/personalize-row-limits.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-diner/tests/personalize-rich-copy.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines, and the 'ok' line of every test named in run.tests.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests'.

Menu planner (apps/tracy-web emdash-menus.js) on the real Restaurant seed: the planner's 'Explore → Menu' is asked again and dropped because the item leading to /menu (never planned) already shows 'Menu'; a rename to the label of an item whose own rename was dropped ('Reservation → Explore') is dropped too; no label of the primary menu is shown twice.

Rich-text copy (tools/personalize.mjs writeCopy) on the real Restaurant seed: every rich-text copy field is asked; hero.welcome-to-res-bar-restaurant.hero_intro is written back as blocks with no 'maps', 'Brooklyn' or '5th' left and the new linked words as plain text; a link out of the site stays only on the demo's own words; the '#' link of welcome-to-res-bar-restaurant-2 keeps its address on new words; the 'Meet Our Team' button block of features_intro.about-us stays byte for byte; an answer that drops or invents a placeholder is not taken; Diner's chef card keeps its h4 heading.
A root written in Vietnamese: the template's rich-text copy is translated with its link marks, emphasis and button kept.

Slideshow title bound: seed/personalize.json slideshow rule maxCharacters.slide_title equals the 1.0.2 template-kit maxCharacters (39) for every slide; a 61-character title is not taken; 37 characters fit 37 and not 36.

selectors.tool: packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-*/tools/personalize.mjs (writeCopy, richCopyOf, richFromAnswer, blockFromMarked, leadsOutside, rewriteBlock maxCharacters)

evidence: QA on dev 16/11/2026: a JA Restaurant EmDash site (tracy-restaurant/emdash-0.x 1.0.2) made through POST /api/sites for 'Trattoria Lume', Italian, Da Nang, no address: the main menu read MENU twice (the 'Explore' dropdown renamed 'Menu' by the planner), the home welcome still read 'Since 1982 … 4 5th Avenue at St. Marks Place … Brooklyn' (writeCopy read only string fields, hero_intro is portable text), and the five-line slideshow title ended 10 px above the bottom of a box that cuts what overflows (no bound on the blocks rule). Every test named in run.tests fails on the code before this fix.
fence: The menu planner's plan (planMenuLabels → withoutRepeats) and the personalize tool's writes (writeCopy → richFromAnswer → blockFromMarked; rewriteBlock with maxCharacters), checked on their output with a stand-in model.

tests: a new label never repeats a label its menu shows that was not planned
a rename that repeats the label of an item whose own rename was dropped is dropped too
every rich-text copy field of this template is asked
the home welcome is rewritten, and its map link never goes with new words
a link into the site keeps its address on new words
the "Meet Our Team" button of Our Food Network survives the rewrite of its text
every rich-text copy field is asked, and an answer of its shape comes back as blocks
a root written in Vietnamese: the rich-text copy is translated, its button and its links kept
the slideshow rule bounds its titles by the number the contract measured
a slide title over the bound is not taken, one within it is, and the model is told the bound
the bound counts a run of spaces or line breaks as one, and a rule with no bound takes any length
